rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a small showy ornament or cheap piece of jewellery.

example.english: This bauble is pretty, but it isn't worth much.
example.traditional: 呢件飾物幾靚，不過唔值幾多錢。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 sik1 mat6 gei2 leng3 bat1 gwo3 m4 zik6 gei2 do1 cin2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the shiny spherical decorations hung on a Christmas tree.

example.english: We hung the bauble on the Christmas tree together.
example.traditional: 我哋一齊將聖誕球掛喺棵聖誕樹上。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zoeng1 sing3 daan3 kau4 gwaa3 hai2 fo2 sing3 daan3 syu6 soeng6
